messages.content: You are a helpful assistant. Include a title at the top. Format the title line using this exact prefix: "Title: ". Do not use any of these punctuation marks: ['?']. Finish with "Plug in." and don’t add anything after it. Use exactly 20 words in total. (A "word" is a run of English letters A–Z/a–z; apostrophes inside words are allowed.)

I work for a software development company named "grid", and they want a catchy tweet. Can you write one that includes the name of the company? The final line of your response must be exactly: "Plug in.". Avoid these punctuation characters entirely: ['?']. Make the total word count exactly 20.
